overview.title: liveBook (advertisement)
overview.main_topic: Manning's advertisement for its liveBook online reading platform.
overview.central_idea: Publisher back matter describing liveBook, the online version of Manning books; no deep-learning content.
overview.importance: Not part of the teaching content. Practically relevant only because a liveBook version (with one-click code copy) comes with the book.
learning_objectives: Recognize that this page is publisher back matter, not book content

summary:
A Manning **advertisement** titled "A new online reading experience". It says a liveBook version is included free with every Manning book, and lists its features: your own notes and bookmarks, one-click code copy, a discussion forum, audio recordings and interactive exercises, and reading purchased content in any browser. It also says you can browse any Manning book in liveBook, with a footnote limiting open reading to 10 minutes per book per day. More information: www.manning.com/livebook-program.

There is no deep-learning content on this page.
takeaways: Publisher advertisement for the liveBook platform; not book content.
One-click code copy in liveBook can be handy for running the book's listings.
